podcast.name: The AI Daily Brief (formerly The AI Breakdown)
podcast.feed_url_note: Leave blank to auto-resolve from apple_podcast_id via the iTunes lookup API on each run. Fill it in to pin a specific feed and skip resolution.

delivery.method_note: The Gmail connector can create drafts but cannot send. The run leaves a finished draft addressed to `to` in the from_account. Per JR's standing rule (see CLAUDE.md), self-addressed mail should be SENT without asking whenever a send path exists — draft-only is a tooling limit, not a preference.
delivery.auto_forward_note: Zero-tap path: the Routine emails its run summary to from_account, and a one-time Gmail forwarding filter relays it to `to`. See README.md.
delivery.subject_prefix: AI Daily Brief — tactics to try

actionable_signals: prompting techniques, prompt structure, or system-prompt advice
how to use a specific model well (Claude, GPT, Gemini) — e.g. 'how to get the most out of X'
agent / Claude Code / tool-use workflow patterns
concrete workflows, evals, or context-engineering practice
named frameworks or repeatable processes a listener could run tomorrow
skip_signals: policy, regulation, and legal commentary with no listener action

audience_context.who: JR — works with Salesforce CSMs and AEs on Claude Code enablement (see repo index.html)
prompt_targets: Claude Code artifacts — CLAUDE.md rules, slash commands, terminal workflows
audience_context.bias: Favor tactics that translate into customer-facing enablement or JR's own daily work. Skip anything that only matters to model researchers.

output.one_tactic_framing_note: The draft lands at 7pm, after the workday. The single highlighted tactic is framed for the next working day, not the current one.
